thag1.107:1.1: pabbajiṃ tulayitvāna agārasmānagāriyaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsana’nti. itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā dhammasavo thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā’ti. dhammasavattheragāthā. 1. 11. 8. sa vīsaṃvassasatiko pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ,
thag1.107:1.5: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā dhammasavapitutthero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā’ti.
